newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London up, hi-tech issues gain.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London up, hi-tech issues gain.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mostly firmer on Monday, supported by solid performances by hi-tech issues and shares in the bank sector, dealers said.
Dealers said the earlier buying of high-technology stocks by pension funds in Tokyo spilled over into London and market-makers reacted by marking their quotes higher.
Shares in electronics company Hitachi Ltd rose 2.5 yen above its Tokyo closing to 1282.5 yen by 1415 GMT, while shares in Canon Inc also gained 2.5 yen to 3340 yen.
Dealers said banking shares firmed, recovering from recent worries about bad debts and financial scandals in the sector.
Sakura Bank advanced 4.5 yen to 811.5 yen and Fuji Bank stock gained 5 yen to 1635 yen.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index rose 2.63 points to 1,643.27, after the Nikkei 225 index had earlier climbed 353.23 points to close at 20,228.72
